payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing the similarity measure to BM25, indicating a clear improvement in average precision and NDCG scores.

claims.text: The embedding approach boosts the average precision of BM25 by 19% and 6% on TREC 2006 and 2007, respectively.
Using titles (BM25 + SEMTitle) increases NDCG@20 by 23%, outperforming BM25.
Our proposed method achieves stronger performance than BM25 on TREC and PubMed datasets.
The semantic measure alone produces better ranking scores on the TREC set compared to BM25.
